compute_mae: compute the mean absolute error between predicted and target tensor values for MLIP evaluation
compute_mse: compute the mean squared error between predicted and target tensor values for MLIP evaluation
compute_per_atom_mae: compute the per-atom mean absolute error by dividing MAE by the number of atoms
evaluate_energy_forces_within_threshold: evaluate how many systems have energy error below 0.02 and max force error below 0.03
get_metrics_fn_by_name: get a callable metric function by its string name such as mae mse or rmse
